claims.claim: The recorded target is dimensionally inconsistent: literal ISO A9-in-A1 has optimum 258, so it is neither 518 nor 519.
claims.evidence: The authorized source gives A1 dimensions 594×841 and A9 dimensions 37×52. Their areas are 499554 and 1924. Thus even 518 A9 sheets would require area 996632>499554. Claim 1 independently establishes the exact optimum 258 by matching lower and upper certificates. Therefore neither 518 nor 519 is possible for literal A9-in-A1.
claims.witness: Dimension witness: A1=594×841, A9=37×52, with 518·37·52=996632>594·841=499554. The exact 258-packing and scale-35 upper certificate are reproduced in the checker.
claims.search_method: Read the exact target and authorized ISO dimension table, performed exact integer area calculations, and independently reproduced the complete placement and upper-bound proof.

claims.claim: OPT(594,841,52,37)=258, with an explicit placement and a periodic upper-bound certificate.
claims.evidence: The proposed strip construction generates exactly 258 rectangles of dimensions 37×52 or 52×37. Exact unit-cell checking found no overlap, verified containment, and counted 496392=258·1924 covered cells. For the upper bound, flooring each real lower-left coordinate preserves containment and any pairwise separating inequality because all side lengths and container boundaries are integers. Hence integer placements suffice. With column residues {2,9,16,24,31}, row residues {5,12,19,27,34} modulo 37, and scale 35, exhaustive checking of all 877935 integer placements found minimum scaled rectangle weight 35. The container weight is 80·113=9040<259·35=9065, so every packing has fewer than 259 rectangles. The matching construction proves OPT=258.
claims.witness: Lower certificate: two 37-wide strips each contain sixteen 37×52 rectangles; each of the two 260-wide strips contains four rows of seven 37×52 rectangles followed by seventeen rows of five 52×37 rectangles. Upper certificate: modulus 37, column residues {2,9,16,24,31}, row residues {5,12,19,27,34}, scale 35, total scaled weight 9040.
claims.search_method: Generated every stated construction rectangle, checked every covered unit cell with integers, verified all cyclic residue starts, exhaustively evaluated both orientations at every integer translate, and proved the flooring reduction algebraically.

claims.claim: If the intended 518/519 instance is ISO A10-in-A1, its exact optimum is 518.
claims.evidence: The strip construction generates 518 A10 rectangles: 64 in the 74-wide strip and 454 in the 520-wide strip. Exact checking verified dimensions 26×37 or 37×26, containment, non-overlap, and 498316=518·962 covered cells. For the upper certificate, use residues {2,6,10,14,17,21,25,28,32,36} modulo 37 on both axes and scale 70. Exhaustive checking of all 913373 integer placements found minimum scaled weight 70. The container has 160 marked columns and 227 marked rows, so total scaled weight is 36320<519·70=36330. The same valid flooring reduction extends the bound to arbitrary real coordinates, proving OPT=518.
claims.witness: Lower certificate: widths 74+520; the first strip has 32 rows of two 37×26 rectangles, while the second has fifteen rows of twenty 26×37 rectangles and eleven rows of fourteen 37×26 rectangles. Upper certificate: modulus 37, residues {2,6,10,14,17,21,25,28,32,36} on both axes, scale 70, total scaled weight 36320.
claims.search_method: Generated and cell-checked the full construction, verified the periodic interval counts at every cyclic start, exhaustively evaluated both orientations at every integer translate, and applied the independently checked flooring lemma.

target_evidence: The exact target presents a false 518-or-519 dichotomy for literal ISO A9-in-A1. The draft resolves the target at full strength rather than giving a coarser or mismatched result: it proves the exact literal optimum 258, supplies an explicit placement, supplies a checkable periodic upper certificate, and justifies the reduction from arbitrary real coordinates to integer coordinates. It also identifies and exactly resolves the apparent intended A10-in-A1 instance as 518. Accordingly, the headline assertion of complete resolution is established and claimed_resolution FULL is accurate.
